qa_pairs.question: What is the overlapping distance A that should be marked toward the front when preparing a new trunk floor plate?
qa_pairs.answer: The overlapping distance A should be 20 mm (0.787") toward the front.

qa_pairs.question: What important safety consideration is mentioned when cutting off the trunk floor plate?
qa_pairs.answer: Don't damage the side members when cutting off the trunk floor plate along the marked line.

qa_pairs.question: What should be done to the connections of the left and right side members before lifting off the trunk floor plate?
qa_pairs.answer: Uncover the connections of the left and right side members and drill out spot welds before lifting off the trunk floor plate complete with side members.

qa_pairs.question: What tool should be used when shouldering the overlap upwards with sheet metal?
qa_pairs.answer: Use shouldering pliers when shouldering the overlap upwards with sheet metal.

qa_pairs.question: What needs to be done to prepare the mating surfaces after removing scrap metal?
qa_pairs.answer: Straighten and grind mating surfaces after removing scrap metal.

qa_pairs.question: Where should the car be positioned when fitting in the trunk floor plate?
qa_pairs.answer: Set up the car on a straightening bench when fitting in the trunk floor plate.

qa_pairs.question: What should be marked on the trunk floor plate according to the bottom right image?
qa_pairs.answer: Mark the location of cross member on the trunk floor plate.

qa_pairs.question: What diagram number corresponds to the image showing the removal of scrap metal?
qa_pairs.answer: Diagram number 30 41 610 corresponds to the image showing removal of scrap metal.

qa_pairs.question: What preparation step is mentioned for the new trunk floor plate?
qa_pairs.answer: Prepare new trunk floor plate for partial replacement by marking the line on transition and marking overlapping distance A.

qa_pairs.question: What diagram number shows the car set up on the straightening bench?
qa_pairs.answer: Diagram number 30 41 617 shows the car set up on the straightening bench with the trunk floor plate being fitted.

qa_pairs.question: What should be done with spot welds during the disassembly process?
qa_pairs.answer: Drill out spot welds after uncovering the connections of the left and right side members.

qa_pairs.question: What diagram number corresponds to the image showing the cutting of sheet metal with shouldering pliers?
qa_pairs.answer: Diagram number 30 41 616 corresponds to the image showing cutting off sheet metal and shouldering the overlap upwards with shouldering pliers.
